verdict.rationale: Cactus explicitly documents running the platform from "a coding agent with your API key." It backs this with agent-oriented material: an llms.txt (confirmed live by probe), a REST API reference (generations, tool_schemas, uploads, billing), and an OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json. The local engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration of a coding agent actually driving the platform end-to-end, no dedicated agent integration such as an MCP server, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at root-level paths, though one is documented under /v1.
